correctness.rationale: All covering assumptions, free action and sphere counts are justified. Exhaustive n=4,5 orbit-cell boundary constructions check ∂²=0 over Z and complete GF2 ranks. Two-sheet transfer and UCT give the entire integral homology. A concrete covering cocycle is nontrivial; its square and cube raise coboundary rank by exactly one, proving the ring.

originality.rationale: The accepted novelty is the exact integral orbit-space torsion and nontrivial third power of the covering cohomology class for n=4,5. The earlier sphere-wedge theorem and rational character are acknowledged premises; their statements cannot imply these integral multiplicative quotient invariants. Closest complete accessible papers were compared; an unindexed exact equivalent remains a residual risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed or differently titled prior computation of these two exact geometric quotient rings may exist.
The exact ring is not an integral homotopy classification, and extension beyond n=5 is unproved.

value.rationale: Computes new integral and multiplicative invariants for the first two natural nontrivial antipodal hypercube Rips quotients, beyond existing rational character information. The exact Z/2 torsion and nonvanishing degree-three cup power are structurally motivated by the free double covering and are not numerical recomputations of the cover Betti numbers.
